name: @cori.data
description: Credential-vending Lambda + CDK infrastructure for cori.data::connect_to_s3

scripts.cname-target: aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name CoriDataVendCredentials --region us-east-1 --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='CnameTarget'].OutputValue" --output text
scripts.outputs: aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name CoriDataVendCredentials --region us-east-1 --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[].{Output:OutputKey,Value:OutputValue}" --output table
scripts.test:env: env -u AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID -u AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY -u AWS_SESSION_TOKEN     AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=/dev/null AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null && HOME=/tmp/fake_home  R
